comparison.authoritative_statement: Under interleaved A/B testing (N=11 evaluated pairs), unconstrained baseline median is 36.55 ms/tok (IQR 2.97) vs engine median 37.49 ms/tok (IQR 1.62), yielding a net overhead of +0.94 ms/tok (+2.6%).
